encode(source) =
    join(string(length(m.match), first(m.match)) for m in eachmatch(r"([A-Z])\1*", source))
decode(encoded) = replace(
    encoded,
    r"[0-9]+[A-Z]" => run -> repeat(string(run[end]), parse(Int, run[1:(end-1)])),
)
for source in [
    "WWWWWWWWWWWWBWWWWWWWWWWWWBBB",
]
    encoded = encode(source)
    decoded = decode(encoded)
    println(source, " -> ", encoded, " -> ", decoded)
end
